Name: Ginger Elliott
Author: RogueLesbian
Description:
When a friend pointed out that Elliott was, in fact, a dirty blonde rather than a redhead, I was horrified! I used to play on mobile and somehow convinced myself he was a ginger, to realize he wasn't hurt. So, I decided to rectify the situation!

This will likely be part of a series of mods of me making Pelican Town ginger! (Except Lewis, he doesn't deserve ginger status.)

Manifest.Name: Ginger Elliott
Manifest.Description: I made Elliott better. He is now a superior being, also known as a ginger.
